Name: Dynamic festival rewards
Author: mistyspring
Description:
[size=3]This mod is a fill for[url=https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-ideas/issues/1131] this idea [/url]on Github.

This mod has dynamic rewards for vanilla festivals, but you can request for mod support.

The money is calculated like this:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]A random number is chosen (min/max configurable).[/size]
[*][size=3]You get (score * random) money.[/size]
[/list][size=3]

If you like what i do, [url=https://ko-fi.com/mistyspring][b]consider buying me a coffee [/b][b]♥.[/b][/url]
[/size]
